properties.name: NotesCanvas • From Notes to Knowing
properties.description:
NotesCanvas is a structured thinking tool for people who refuse to think in straight lines.

Most note-taking apps are built for capture. 

NotesCanvas is built for thinking — the messy, non-linear, connection-making kind that happens before you know what you’re trying to say.

At its core is the Thinking Model Canvas — a methodology that holds your entire thinking process in a single coherent space. 

It orients you through four natural stages: Prompt → Inquiry → Discovery → Response. And across four associative dimensions: Tensions, Context, Supports, Emerges. 

Not as a rigid workflow, but as a living map — one that lets you see where you are, what you’re missing, and what’s beginning to take shape.

Where other tools flatten your ideas into bullet points or sticky notes, the Thinking Model Canvas helps you think across a problem rather than just into it. 

Surfaces contradictions. Holds complexity. Reveals connections you wouldn’t have found by going deeper into a single lane.

AI is available — but optional. Cognitive sovereignty is a design principle here, not an afterthought. 

NotesCanvas is built for thinkers who want to stay in the driver’s seat.

Who it’s for: Researchers, strategists, consultants, writers, and polymaths who work at the intersection of disciplines — and who know that the quality of your thinking instrument determines the quality of what you’ll be able to see next.

NotesCanvas - From Notes to Knowing.

entity.name: NotesCanvas • From Notes to Knowing
entity.description:
NotesCanvas is a structured thinking tool for people who refuse to think in straight lines.

Most note-taking apps are built for capture. 

NotesCanvas is built for thinking — the messy, non-linear, connection-making kind that happens before you know what you’re trying to say.

At its core is the Thinking Model Canvas — a methodology that holds your entire thinking process in a single coherent space. 

It orients you through four natural stages: Prompt → Inquiry → Discovery → Response. And across four associative dimensions: Tensions, Context, Supports, Emerges. 

Not as a rigid workflow, but as a living map — one that lets you see where you are, what you’re missing, and what’s beginning to take shape.

Where other tools flatten your ideas into bullet points or sticky notes, the Thinking Model Canvas helps you think across a problem rather than just into it. 

Surfaces contradictions. Holds complexity. Reveals connections you wouldn’t have found by going deeper into a single lane.

AI is available — but optional. Cognitive sovereignty is a design principle here, not an afterthought. 

NotesCanvas is built for thinkers who want to stay in the driver’s seat.

Who it’s for: Researchers, strategists, consultants, writers, and polymaths who work at the intersection of disciplines — and who know that the quality of your thinking instrument determines the quality of what you’ll be able to see next.

NotesCanvas - From Notes to Knowing.

entity.name: Clarity
entity.description:
Your company makes decisions. We make sure they stick.

Clarity AI is the Decision Intelligence platform for scaling companies. We detect strategy-execution drift before it becomes expensive.

As companies scale past 50 people, decisions made in one system fail to translate into execution in others. A pricing call in Slack never reaches the sprint in Linear. A product pivot in Notion contradicts the roadmap in GitHub. Context fragments. Alignment decays. We call this the Decision Tax — and it costs scaling companies $600K–$1.75M per year in rework, misalignment, and lost velocity.
Clarity connects to your existing toolchain — Slack, Linear, GitHub, Notion, HubSpot — and builds a living organizational memory graph. Every morning, your leadership team gets a MEMO: the decisions that matter, the drift that's forming, and the actions that need attention. No dashboards to check. No workflows to build. Just clarity.

The Clarity Suite:
→ MEMO — Daily intelligence briefings for leadership
→ Investigation — Natural language queries across your organizational data
→ Simulation — Decision modeling and scenario planning
→ Tracking — Outcome measurement against decisions made

Built by operators who scaled CoinDCX to India's first crypto unicorn — and bled from the exact problem Clarity solves.

We're working with design partners now. If your company is 50–300 people and you've felt the pain of losing visibility as you scale, let's talk.

entity.description:
PARA- the computer behind a phone number.

Every AI tool waits for you to come to it. Open an app, learn a dashboard, switch tabs. We think that's backwards. The agent should come to you.

PARA is a research agent that lives in WhatsApp, Slack, iMessage, and ChatGPT. It knows what you're building, watches 50+ source types, and tells you when something changes that matters to your work. No app, no dashboard. You text it like you'd text a colleague.

We built PARA because we needed it. As builders, we were drowning in papers, podcasts, Slack threads, Twitter, newsletters and nothing connected any of it. We tried scrapers, RSS, Zapier workflows, and more but that became just another feed.

The part we didn't plan for: we launched on WhatsApp and users started adding PARA to group chats. It's just a phone number, so they could. People began researching together with an AI agent in the middle, asking questions from different angles, pressure-testing ideas with real sources mid-conversation. PARA went from personal researcher to the person running the group.

800+ people joined in 5 days. All organic, zero outbound. Enterprise clients are deploying PARA for their teams. A state police department is in active talks for department-wide integration. Every customer came to us.

AI solved execution. Coding, design, writing are all faster than ever. Research is the bottleneck now. PARA finds the evidence and tells you what you don't know that you don't know.

Cursor owns coding. Figma owns design. Staying informed and making decisions with confidence - that's PARA.

Founded by Akhil Agrawal and Shivesh Pandey. 
We use PARA to build PARA everyday.

entity.name: Orvyn Labs
entity.description:
Orvyn is building the AI-native operating system for enterprise knowledge.

Modern organizations generate enormous volumes of documents - contracts, reports, financial models, emails, research, and internal decisions. Yet most of this knowledge remains trapped inside files, scattered across drives, SaaS tools, and internal systems.

As companies race to adopt AI, this fragmented information creates a fundamental problem: AI systems require structured context, but enterprise knowledge exists as unstructured documents.

Orvyn solves this by transforming enterprise files into a structured, computable knowledge layer.

Our platform automatically processes organizational documents, extracts entities and relationships, and builds a live enterprise knowledge graph that both humans and AI systems can reason over.

This enables organizations to:

• discover information instantly
• automate document-heavy workflows
• deploy reliable AI agents
• maintain consistent organizational context across teams and systems

Orvyn begins with AI-powered DataRooms, turning critical document workflows such as fundraising, audits, and due diligence into intelligent knowledge environments.

Over time, the platform evolves into the operating context layer that powers AI-driven enterprises.

entity.name: Lapu.Ai
entity.description:
Desktop AI agent that executes real work on your machine. Local-first. Permissioned. Shipping now on macOS and Windows.

Lapu AI is the desktop AI agent layer — software that runs natively on your machine, executes real tasks, and puts you in control.

Unlike browser-based AI tools, Lapu AI operates at the OS level with direct access to your files, terminal, and desktop applications. It doesn't suggest what to do next. It does it, with your approval.

What makes Lapu AI different:

- Desktop-native — runs as a native app with direct access to your filesystem, running applications, and system APIs. No browser sandbox.
- Built-in AI — frontier model reasoning built into the product. No API keys to manage, no model providers to configure.
- Permissioned — every risky action requires your explicit approval. Full audit trail of everything the agent does.
- Local-first — your files stay on your machine. Only relevant context is sent to AI model providers when the agent reasons.

Use cases: document processing, data extraction, file management, research synthesis, recurring reports, cross-app workflows, and desktop automation.

Available now on macOS and Windows. Free to start, no credit card required.

Stop trading your team’s brilliance for the illusion of productivity.

It’s time to build organizations that actually achieve what they set out to do.

The era of fragmentation is over. 

Join us in shaping the future of execution. Apply for our Design Partner program for early access at www.ebben.ai.

Syncable turns a Git repo into production‑ready infrastructure — and keeps it reliable after launch.

What Syncable does

Connects to your Git repository and maps your architecture (services, dependencies, impact of changes)
Deploys to your cloud with production defaults (environments, access control, networking, observability, rollbacks, GitOps)
Watches “golden signals” in production and connects incidents back to the exact service and code path
Reduces Kubernetes waste by using Prometheus metrics + manifests to recommend safe resource changes
Runs on AWS, GCP, Azure, and EU providers like Hetzner. You keep full ownership of your infrastructure — Syncable removes the DevOps toil.

우리는 본능적으로 도구를 만드는 존재이지만, 대부분의 사람들은 매일 사용하는 소프트웨어 - 아마도 가장 강력한 도구 - 를 직접 만들거나 수정할 수 없습니다. Notion 팀은 모든 사람이 자신의 삶을 이뤄나가는 도구를 직접 만들 수 있게 돕는 것을 사명으로 삼고 있습니다.
